question:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:

a. Eastern Zonal Council meeting 2022

b. States Reorganisation Act passed

c. First Central Zonal Council meeting
solution:
The correct answer is __**b-c-a**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **States Reorganisation Act** was passed in **1956**. It restructured India's states and territories, marking a significant moment in the political and administrative history of the country.
 
• The **First Central Zonal Council meeting** was held after the creation of zonal councils, which were established following the **States Reorganisation Act**. These councils aimed to promote cooperation and coordination between states.
 
• The **Eastern Zonal Council meeting in 2022** occurred significantly later and focused on contemporary issues related to the states in the eastern region of India.
 
• The chronological order of the events is therefore: **States Reorganisation Act passed (b)**, followed by the **First Central Zonal Council meeting (c)**, and finally the **Eastern Zonal Council meeting in 2022 (a)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **States Reorganisation Act**__

 __
 
• The **States Reorganisation Act, 1956** was a major reform that reorganized the boundaries of Indian states and territories based on linguistic lines.
 
• It led to the creation of **14 states** and **6 union territories**.
 
• This Act also provided the basis for the establishment of **Zonal Councils** under the **States Reorganisation Commission**.
 
 
 
• **Zonal Councils**__
 __
 
• The **Zonal Councils** were set up to foster interstate cooperation and coordination, as recommended by the **States Reorganisation Commission**.
 
• They are statutory bodies, established under the **States Reorganisation Act, 1956**.
 
• There are **five Zonal Councils**: Northern, Southern, Eastern, Western, and Central Zonal Councils.
 
• The **Central Zonal Council** includes states like Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and Chhattisgarh.
 
 
 
• **Eastern Zonal Council**__
 
 
• The **Eastern Zonal Council** comprises the states of **West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, and Jharkhand**.
 
• It focuses on issues like **economic and social development, border disputes, and security concerns** specific to the eastern region of India.
 
• The **2022 meeting of the Eastern Zonal Council** aimed at resolving issues related to connectivity, infrastructure, and law and order in the eastern states.
